title: 新加坡有序扩展数据中心容量
titleEn: Tan Kiat How on Singapore's disciplined data centre growth
summary: 新加坡将有序增长数据中心容量，强调虽然AI对未来经济至关重要，但不会为扩展而扩展。
summaryEn: Tan Kiat How explains Singapore will grow data centre capacity in a disciplined way, emphasizing that while AI is important, expansion won't be pursued for its own sake.
speaker: Tan Kiat How
speakerTitle: 通讯及新闻部高级政务部长
speakerTitleEn: Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information, Singapore
